capabilities: Declare calendar events in notes with gcal: code spans
Sync saved notes to Google Calendar on save, on a timer, and on demand
Repeat events with gcal-repeat rules or raw RRULE strings
Pick dates, times and repeats from a panel that rewrites one declaration
Declare a whole note as an event via note properties
extras: Desktop only (sign-in needs a local callback server) and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; the plugin ships no credentials, so you must create your own Google Cloud OAuth client; it contacts only Google hosts and sends no telemetry.
problem: Events written in notes have to be re-entered by hand in Google Calendar, because Obsidian has no way to push them there.

relations.evidence: Write an event in a note. It appears on your Google Calendar.

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth client (your own client ID)

summary: One-way sync that turns gcal: code spans in notes into events on your Google Calendar, with a picker panel and repeat rules.
